summary.intent: Monitor CI checks on cipher-box PR 616 and remove the GSD (.claude/) installation from the repo if it's not actually being used.
summary.outcome: Confirmed the untracked GSD install and its hook wiring in settings.local.json were unused, stripped GSD hooks/permissions from settings.local.json, deleted the untracked GSD install files, verified statusline.cjs had no dependency on the deleted .planning/ directory, and committed the tracked removals to PR 616.

workflow: Before deleting a tool installation embedded in a repo (like GSD under .claude/), separate tracked vs untracked files and check for coupling in settings.local.json (hook wiring, permission entries) and any dependent scripts (e.g. statusline.cjs) before removing anything.

open_items: Watch for PR 616 CI check results (background watcher was running at end of session).
